sampling.selection: all eligible complete components; no random sampling

note: One fitting pool; folds 0/1 are exposed evaluation. Fitting contains complete eligible fold-2/3 components, including permitted train and valid sequences. Evaluation scoring rows are valid-source rows; train counterparts in the same component are recorded and held out.

resource_estimate.estimate_scope: logical NPY sizes including 128-byte headers; excludes small JSON and filesystem allocation rounding
resource_estimate.stage_ram_basis: One ParquetFile reader, one sequence at a time, and per-sequence memmap cache advice; RAM reservation is the prior successful R1 staging bound, not a new measurement.
